terms.gloss: a breaking out, a bursting forth; of soldiers, a sally; an eruption (on the skin; of a volcano)
evidence: Caes. BG 2.33.2: ex oppidō ēruptiōnem fēcērunt (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 8.21: ūniversī ēruptiōnem tentāvēre (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: they made a sally from the town

phrases.latin: subita ex abditō vāstī amnis ēruptiō ārās habet
phrases.english: where a great river bursts suddenly from a hidden source there are altars
